name: IEC pushbutton contact: mushroom head normally open momentary
aliases: pushbutton contact Mushroom Head Normally Open Momentary
summary: Pushbutton contact form: Mushroom Head Normally Open Momentary.
description: A pushbutton translates a person pressing an operator into a change of electrical contact state. The operator form and the contact state are separate pieces of information, so a mushroom head can operate either a normally-open or a normally-closed contact. This entry identifies the mushroom head normally open momentary form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

On a machine control sheet, this form lets the reader distinguish the physical button action from the contact used by the controller. Link every contact block to the same operator tag, including a separate indication lamp when fitted. The normally-open designation starts with a non-conducting output or open contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state. The momentary operator returns after it is released; the control logic must not assume that its mechanical state remains latched.

The head shape and contact drawing do not establish a safety category, contact rating or emergency-stop suitability. Direct opening, reset behaviour and the selected assembly must be confirmed from its documentation.
